name: Real-Time Raycasting for Implicit Isosurfaces
aliases: Implicit Isosurface Display via Single-Pass Raycasting
Real-Time Ray-Casting and Advanced Shading of Discrete Isosurfaces
definition: A technique to display implicit isosurfaces from a volume defined on a rectilinear 3D grid using single-pass raycasting and a two-level hierarchical grid representation.
